Apollo.name: Barricade Kit
Apollo.description: A deployable cover that can block incoming damage until it breaks.

Apollo.name: Blaze Grenade
Apollo.description: A grenade that detonates on impact, covering an area in fire that deals damage over time.

Apollo.name: Dockmaster's Detector
Apollo.description: These detectors seem to be able to locate foreign objects buried in the sands around Riven Tides, though their exact way of functioning is unknown.

Apollo.name: Door Blocker
Apollo.description: A locking mechanism that can be placed on large metal doors to limit access.

Apollo.name: Gas Grenade
Apollo.description: A grenade that emits a lingering toxic cloud on impact, draining the stamina of any Raiders within its area of effect.

Apollo.name: Heavy Fuze Grenade
Apollo.description: A grenade that detonates after a delay, dealing explosive damage in its radius.

Apollo.name: Light Impact Grenade
Apollo.description: A grenade that detonates on impact, dealing explosive damage in a small radius.

Apollo.name: Noisemaker
Apollo.description: A deployable proximity sensor that sounds an alarm when enemy Raiders are detected.

Apollo.name: Pulse Mine
Apollo.description: A proximity-triggered mine that pops up and knocks back anything within its radius.

Apollo.name: Recorder
Apollo.description: A playable recorder used to attract ARC's attention, and impress other Raiders.

Apollo.name: Seeker Grenade
Apollo.description: A homing grenade that targets a single nearby ARC dealing explosive damage on impact.

Apollo.name: Shrapnel Grenade
Apollo.description: A makeshift fuze grenade that bursts into razor-sharp fragments upon detonation.

Apollo.name: Smoke Grenade
Apollo.description: A grenade that creates a lingering smoke cloud on impact, blocking visibility from ARC and other Raiders.

Apollo.name: Snap Blast Grenade
Apollo.description: A grenade that sticks to surfaces, dealing explosive damage after a short delay.

Apollo.name: Surge Coil
Apollo.description: A deployable device that periodically electrifies the area around itself and briefly stuns anything caught within it.

Apollo.name: Tagging Grenade
Apollo.description: A grenade that detonates after a delay, tagging Raiders and ARC enemies in an area, allowing you to briefly track their location.

Apollo.name: Trigger 'Nade
Apollo.description: A remote-detonated grenade that can stick to surfaces and ARC, dealing explosive damage when triggered.

Apollo.name: Zipline
Apollo.description: A deployable zipline that allows you to quickly move between two locations.

Lance.name: Adrenaline Shot
Lance.description: A serum that fully restores stamina and temporarily increases stamina regeneration.

Lance.name: Bandage
Lance.description: A medical item that gradually restores health over time.

Lance.name: Combat Mk. 1
Lance.description: Basic combat augment. Supports stronger shields, but with limited backpack capacity and Quick Use slots.

Lance.name: Combat Mk. 2
Lance.description: A combat augment more focused on maneuverability than absorbing damage.

Lance.name: Combat Mk. 3 (Flanking)
Lance.description: A combat augment more focused on maneuverability than absorbing damage.

Lance.name: Defibrillator
Lance.description: An injection that quickly revives downed raiders and restores some health.

Lance.name: Heavy Shield
Lance.description: A heavy shield that blocks a large portion of incoming damage, but carries a significant cost to mobility.

Lance.name: Herbal Bandage
Lance.description: An improvised medical item that gradually restores health over time.

Lance.name: Light Shield
Lance.description: A lightweight shield that blocks a small portion of incoming damage without impacting mobility.

Lance.name: Looting Mk. 1
Lance.description: Basic looting augment. More backpack slots and weight capacity, but low defensive and tactical capability.

Lance.name: Looting Mk. 2
Lance.description: Significantly increases looting potential; adds slots for trinkets.

Lance.name: Looting Mk. 3 (Cautious)
Lance.description: A looting augment that swaps some carry capacity to increase survivability.

Lance.name: Medium Shield
Lance.description: A standard shield that blocks a medium portion of incoming damage at a moderate cost to mobility.

Lance.name: Shield Recharger
Lance.description: A handheld kit that gradually recharges shield over time.

Lance.name: Sterilized Bandage
Lance.description: A medical item that gradually restores a large amount health over time.

Lance.name: Surge Shield Recharger
Lance.description: A handheld kit that recharges a shield on use.

Lance.name: Tactical Mk. 1
Lance.description: Basic tactical augment. More Quick Use slots for more tactical choice, but limited survivability and slightly lower looting potential.

Lance.name: Tactical Mk. 2
Lance.description: Adds more backpack space and an extra utility item slot.

Lance.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Healing)
Lance.description: A healing-focused augment which adds extra slots for healing items.

Shani.name: Advanced Camera
Shani.description: A more advanced camera with a few extra bells and whistles.

Shani.name: Basic Camera
Shani.description: A simple little camera that gets the job done.

Shani.name: Binoculars
Shani.description: A basic pair of binoculars with two levels of magnification.

Shani.name: Blue Light Stick
Shani.description: A throwable chemical light that illuminates the area around it.

Shani.name: Firecracker
Shani.description: A device that sparks and pops in a pleasant manner.

Shani.name: Fireworks Box
Shani.description: A remotely triggered arrangement of dazzling fireworks, sure to put on a show.

Shani.name: Green Light Stick
Shani.description: A throwable chemical light that illuminates the area around it.

Shani.name: Red Light Stick
Shani.description: A throwable chemical light that illuminates the area around it.

Shani.name: Remote Raider Flare
Shani.description: A deployable device that, when manually triggered, launches a Raider Distress Flare.

Shani.name: Yellow Light Stick
Shani.description: A throwable chemical light that illuminates the area around it.

TianWen.name: Angled Grip I
TianWen.description: Slightly reduces horizontal recoil.

TianWen.name: Angled Grip II
TianWen.description: Moderately reduces horizontal recoil.

TianWen.name: Angled Grip III
TianWen.description: Significantly reduces horizontal recoil.

TianWen.name: Arpeggio I
TianWen.description: Has decent damage output and accuracy.

TianWen.name: Bantam I
TianWen.description: Short-barrel revolver with varied fire rate, good handling and damage, but with low accuracy, control and range.

TianWen.name: Burletta I
TianWen.description: Has decent damage output and accuracy.

TianWen.name: Energy Clip
TianWen.description: Ammo used for energy weapons. One clip will fully charge a single weapon.

TianWen.name: Extended Light Mag I
TianWen.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.

TianWen.name: Extended Light Mag II
TianWen.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.

TianWen.name: Extended Medium Mag II
TianWen.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.

TianWen.name: Ferro I
TianWen.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.

TianWen.name: Ferro IV
TianWen.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.

TianWen.name: Heavy Ammo
TianWen.description: Heavy bullets used mainly with large-caliber weapons.

TianWen.name: Il Toro I
TianWen.description: Has a large bullet spread, sharp falloff, and high damage output.

TianWen.name: Kettle I
TianWen.description: Quick and accurate, but has low bullet velocity and takes a long time to reload.

TianWen.name: Launcher Ammo
TianWen.description: Anti-ARC payloads used mainly by the Hullcracker.

TianWen.name: Light Ammo
TianWen.description: Light bullets used mainly with SMGs and light handguns. Such as Kettle, Stitcher, Burletta, Hairpin and Bobcat.

TianWen.name: Medium Ammo
TianWen.description: Medium bullets used mainly with medium-caliber weapons. Such as Rattler, Tempest, Arpeggio, Renegade and Torrente.

TianWen.name: Muzzle Brake I
TianWen.description: Slightly reduces both vertical recoil & horizontal recoil.

TianWen.name: Osprey I
TianWen.description: Has reliable damage output and accuracy.

TianWen.name: Padded Stock
TianWen.description: Significantly improves stability.

TianWen.name: Rascal
TianWen.description: Fires explosive projectiles that only detonate when hitting ARC.

TianWen.name: Renegade I
TianWen.description: Has high damage output, accuracy, and headshot damage.

TianWen.name: Shotgun Ammo
TianWen.description: Shotgun shells used for shotguns.

TianWen.name: Shotgun Choke II
TianWen.description: Moderately reduces base dispersion.

TianWen.name: Silencer I
TianWen.description: Slightly reduces the amount of noise produced when firing.

TianWen.name: Stable Stock III
TianWen.description: Significantly improves dispersion & recoil recovery time.

TianWen.name: Stitcher I
TianWen.description: Has a good damage output, but has a low fire-rate for an SMG, and can be hard to control.

TianWen.name: Torrente I
TianWen.description: Has a large ammo capacity, but is only accurate while crouched.

TianWen.name: Vertical Grip II
TianWen.description: Moderately reduces vertical recoil.

item.name: Anvil II
item.description: Has high damage output and headshot damage, but slow handling.

item.name: Dam Staff Room Key
item.description: Unlocks a door in the Research and Administration building on Dam Battlegrounds.

item.name: Exodus Technical Handbook
item.description: Filled with equal parts obscure jargon and complex diagrams.

item.name: Acoustic Guitar
item.description: A playable acoustic guitar used to attract ARC's attention, and impress other Raiders.

item.name: Hullcracker II
item.description: Fires explosive projectiles that only detonate when hitting ARC.

item.name: Powered Descender
item.description: Reduces fall speed when used in the air, but has a wind-up time before reaching full force. Shuts down once out of power.

item.name: Wolfpack
item.description: A grenade that scatters into multiple homing missiles, each one targeting ARC and dealing explosive damage on impact.

permanent_services.name: Expedition Vault
permanent_services.description: Safely stores items between expeditions so they survive your next raid. Upgrades available 5 times. Expedition Vault slots +1 per upgrade (+5 slots total).

permanent_services.name: Stash Expansion
permanent_services.description: Expands your stash size beyond its ordinary limits. Two expansions are available. This upgrade resets if the player departs on an Expedition. Stash slots +12 per expansion (+24 total).
